Models & configurations

Explicit API models across Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Prices are recorded reference rates, not a performance estimate.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001

$1 input / $5 output per MTok

Pricing and configuration

Standard online API rates in USD per million tokens; excludes caching, batch discounts and tools.

Output cap: 1,024 tokens. Model-default reasoning settings.

Official pricing ↗

gemini-3.5-flash-lite

$0.3 input / $2.5 output per MTok

Pricing and configuration

Standard text/image input and output rates. Output includes thinking tokens; no caching or batch discount assumed.

Output cap: 1,024 tokens. Model-default reasoning settings.

Official pricing ↗
openai

Muse Spark 1.2

muse-spark-1.2

$1.25 input / $4.25 output per MTok

Meta Muse Spark 1.2 Standard tier via the OpenAI-compatible Meta Model API Responses endpoint. Reasoning model; uses model-default reasoning settings. 16384 output cap matches 1.3 so both Muse configurations share identical inference settings. Same $1.25/$4.25 standard pricing as 1.3; prompts never train Meta models.

Pricing and configuration

Standard tier rates in USD per million tokens; cached input $0.15/M not assumed. Output includes reasoning tokens.

Output cap: 16,384 tokens. Model-default reasoning settings.

Official pricing ↗

Muse Spark 1.3

muse-spark-1.3

$1.25 input / $4.25 output per MTok

Meta Muse Spark 1.3 Standard tier via the OpenAI-compatible Meta Model API Responses endpoint. Reasoning model at model-default high effort; uses model-default reasoning settings. 16384 output cap: the 4096-cap probe returned status incomplete with all 4096 tokens spent on reasoning, and live outputs reach ~6900 tokens, so 16384 keeps headroom above observed reasoning volume. Same $1.25/$4.25 standard pricing as 1.2; prompts never train Meta models.

Pricing and configuration

Standard tier rates in USD per million tokens; cached input $0.15/M not assumed. Output includes reasoning tokens.
